prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1401; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: Understood. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. I was turning left off the main road into a shopping center parking lot.

Q: What were you driving, and was anyone else in the vehicle?

A: I was driving my sedan. I was alone, no passengers.

Q: Walk me through what happened right before the collision.

A: I had my turn signal on and I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic. There was a truck coming toward me, so I waited for it to pass. Then I started to go, and a car coming the other way was already in the intersection. I tried to brake but it was too late and we hit on the front driver's side.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They said they didn't see my signal, but I'm pretty sure I had it on the whole time.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the airbag came out. I felt immediate pain and couldn't move my hand well.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment?

A: Paramedics took me to the hospital. They did X-rays and said the wrist was fractured. I'm in a splint now and I have a follow-up with a hand specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was being careful and I'd like this looked at fairly. I'm happy to send any photos I took at the scene.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
